title: Plan introduced new files not tracked in epic_manifest.json file_ownership_map
description: plan_phase_epic created 4 new files (visibility.py, middleware.py, logging_config.py, health.py) in the Parallelization Strategy but did not note that these need to be added to epic_manifest.json's file_ownership_map. The file_ownership_map is the authoritative source for cross-epic file conflict prevention during swarm execution.
root_cause: plan_phase_epic does not cross-reference its estimated_files against the epic_manifest.json file_ownership_map. New files introduced by the plan are not validated against the ownership registry.
recommendation: After generating the Parallelization Strategy, plan_phase_epic should compare all estimated_files against epic_manifest.json's file_ownership_map. Any new files should be flagged with a note: 'New file — add to epic_manifest.json epic_N_owns'. Alternatively, the plan should include a 'File Ownership Updates' section that lists additions to the ownership map.
affected_section: Parallelization Strategy generation in plan_phase_epic.md — file list generation.
plan_context: Epic with 12 owned files in epic_manifest.json, plan introduces 4 additional new files
